assumptions: feature_id lấy theo profile của run (FEAT-01-onboarding-dashboard).
Check base giữ applicability environment 'documented'; check mới 'staging'. Key applicability theme_or_device giữ như base.

conflicts.summary: Dashboard đúng 3 section (KB-006) vs có thêm card Sidekick/promo/ATC (KB-032)
'Recently created offers' là list 5 offer + 2 nút (KB-007) vs bảng cột kiểu QVD-27, 'Manage offers' chỉ khi có offer (KB-030)

checks.title: Onboarding empty-state renders immediately post-install for a first-time store (0 offers)

applicability.state: onboarding_empty_state (0 offers)

checks.precondition: Store has never had any offer of any type/status (first install, or an existing store that has genuinely never created an offer).
steps: Install the app (or use a store instance with 0 offers created, ever) and open the app Home screen.
Observe the header, primary CTA, and empty-state card content.
Confirm no dashboard sections (Theme Extension Status Setup Guide Recently created offers) are shown.
checks.observation_point: Home screen immediately after navigating to it, first render
checks.expected_result: Header reads "Hello {{Store name}}!", primary button is "Create offer", and the empty-state card shows "Create your first deal!" "Create your first volume discount offer to get started." "Create offer" button. This is the only view shown; dashboard sections are absent.

checks.title: Dashboard view: các section hiển thị khi store có >=1 offer

applicability.state: dashboard_view (>=1 offer)

checks.precondition: Store has >=1 offer (any type/status).
steps: Navigate to app Home with a store that has >=1 offer.
Observe the sections/cards rendered on the page, top to bottom.
checks.observation_point: Home screen render, dashboard state
checks.open_question_draft: Conflict CONF-onboarding-dashboard-R1018-01 — Dashboard view gồm những gì? Tài liệu (KB-006, cùng KB-001): đúng 3 section Theme Extension Status, Setup Guide, Recently created offers; không hiện view onboarding. Staging 2026-10-18 (KB-032): ngoài 3 section còn card Sidekick ('The right offer, in one prompt', 3 nút prompt), banner promo Transcy BFCM, promo 'Ultimate kit for conversion' và card 'Add to cart click' (hai mục sau chỉ khi có offer), dropdown 'Language:' cuối trang. Các card thêm có thuộc phạm vi và điều kiện hiển thị expected là gì? Cần owner quyết trước khi check này dùng lại được làm oracle.

checks.title: 'Recently created offers': nội dung, thứ tự và nút điều hướng khi store có 1–5 offer

applicability.state: dashboard_view (>=1 offer, <=5 total)

checks.precondition: Store has between 1 and 5 offers, spanning at least 2 different statuses (e.g. one active, one paused).
steps: Create 3-5 offers of mixed status (active/paused/expired).
Navigate to Home, dashboard view.
Inspect the 'Recently created offers' section: item order, included statuses, layout (list/table, columns) and navigation buttons.
checks.observation_point: 'Recently created offers' section of the dashboard
checks.open_question_draft: Conflict CONF-onboarding-dashboard-R1018-02 — 'Recently created offers' hiển thị thế nào? Tài liệu (KB-007, KB-008): danh sách đơn giản 5 offer mới nhất mọi status (correction phủ định bảng phân trang QVD-27), có cả nút 'Manage offers' và 'Create offer'. Staging 2026-10-18 (KB-030): khi có offer hiện bảng cột 'Internal name' / 'Extension type' / 'Status' / 'Trigger' / 'Combination' / 'Actions' + nút 'Manage offers' và 'Create offer'; khi 0 offer chỉ có 'Create offer' và empty state 'Create your first deal!'. Cần owner xác nhận layout hiện hành trước khi check này dùng lại được làm oracle.

checks.title: Theme Extension Status block — Active state content

applicability.state: dashboard_view, Theme Extension Status = Active

checks.precondition: Theme app extension is enabled/active on the store's published theme.
steps: Ensure the theme app extension is active.
Navigate to Home, dashboard view.
Inspect the Theme Extension Status block.
checks.observation_point: Theme Extension Status block, dashboard
checks.expected_result: Status reads "Active"; helper text reads "The created offer is visible on your storefront."; a "Need help?" button is present and opens in-app chat with customer support.

checks.title: Theme Extension Status block — Inactive state content and presence of Enable button

applicability.state: dashboard_view, Theme Extension Status = Inactive

checks.precondition: Theme app extension is disabled/inactive on the store's published theme.
steps: Ensure the theme app extension is inactive.
Navigate to Home, dashboard view.
Inspect the Theme Extension Status block.
checks.observation_point: Theme Extension Status block, dashboard
checks.expected_result: Status reads "Inactive" with explanatory helper text that offers are not visible on storefront because the app embed is inactive; the same "Need help?" button is present, plus an "Enable theme app" button.

checks.title: Setup Guide Step 1 and Step 2 content and primary buttons

applicability.state: dashboard_view, Setup Guide expanded

checks.precondition: Store has >=1 offer (dashboard view showing), Setup Guide is expanded.
steps: Navigate to Home, dashboard view, expand Setup Guide if collapsed.
Inspect Step 1 description and button.
Inspect Step 2 description and button.
checks.observation_point: Setup Guide section, Step 1 and Step 2 rows
checks.expected_result: Step 1 shows the sales-strategy/offer-creation description and a Primary "Create offer" button that opens the offer settings page. Step 2 shows the theme-app-extension description and a Primary "Enable theme app extension" button that opens the theme editor.

checks.title: Setup Guide progress tracker updates dynamically, auto-collapses at 2/2 completed, and can be re-expanded afterward

applicability.state: setup guide, step completion 0/2 -> 1/2 -> 2/2, then collapsed

checks.precondition: Store has >=1 offer (dashboard showing); Setup Guide steps are at varying completion.
steps: Start from 0/2 completed (no offer yet is impossible in dashboard state, so start from 1/2: offer created, theme extension not yet enabled). Observe tracker text.
Complete Step 2 (enable theme app extension).
Observe tracker text and guide collapse state.
After auto-collapse, click the collapsed Setup Guide to re-expand it and observe the steps again.
checks.observation_point: Setup Guide progress tracker header and expand/collapse state
checks.expected_result: Tracker shows '1/2 completed' at one step done, updates to '2/2 completed' once both steps are done, and the guide auto-collapses at 2/2. After auto-collapse, clicking the guide re-expands it and both completed steps remain visible for review.

checks.title: Dashboard ATC click stat widget shows a 30-day add-to-cart click count

applicability.state: dashboard_view, ATC click stat widget

checks.precondition: Store has >=1 offer and at least one storefront add-to-cart event attributable to an offer within the last 30 days.
steps: Generate at least one add-to-cart click on the storefront attributable to an active offer.
Navigate to Home, dashboard view.
Inspect the ATC click stat widget value.
checks.observation_point: ATC click stat widget, dashboard
checks.expected_result: Widget shows the add-to-cart click count for the last 30 days, reflecting the generated event(s).

checks.title: Rapid repeated clicks on the 'Create offer' CTA carry no double-click risk

applicability.state: onboarding_empty_state OR dashboard_view

checks.precondition: Any state showing a 'Create offer' CTA.
steps: Click the 'Create offer' CTA twice in rapid succession (as fast as physically/scriptably possible).
Observe navigation outcome.
checks.observation_point: Page navigated to after the click sequence
checks.expected_result: Exactly one navigation occurs, to the offer-type selection page; the first click navigates away before a second click can register on the same button, so there is no duplicate-action or duplicate-offer risk.

checks.title: Creating the first offer does not auto-redirect to Home/Dashboard

applicability.state: onboarding_empty_state (0 offers), creating first offer

checks.precondition: Store has 0 offers (onboarding state); merchant is mid-flow creating their first offer.
steps: From onboarding, click 'Create offer' and complete creation of the first offer via Save/Publish on the offer settings page.
Observe the page immediately after save -- do NOT navigate manually yet.
Separately, navigate back to Home and observe the view.
checks.observation_point: Page shown immediately after offer save, and Home view on next navigation
checks.expected_result: Immediately after saving, the merchant remains on the offer settings page -- no auto-redirect to Home/Dashboard occurs. Only on the next manual navigation to Home does the view switch to Dashboard.

checks.title: Closing the Theme Editor tab without clicking Save still shows the status block as correctly 'Inactive'

applicability.state: Theme Editor opened via deep-link, Inactive extension, tab closed without Save

checks.precondition: Theme Extension Status is Inactive; merchant opens the Theme Editor via the 'Enable theme app' deep-link.
steps: From Theme Extension Status = Inactive, click 'Enable theme app' to open the Theme Editor in a new tab.
Close the Theme Editor tab WITHOUT clicking Save and without enabling the extension.
Return to the app dashboard tab and inspect the Theme Extension Status block.
checks.observation_point: Theme Extension Status block, dashboard tab, after returning from the closed editor tab
checks.expected_result: Status block correctly still shows 'Inactive' -- no false-positive 'Active' state is shown just because the editor was opened.

checks.title: 'Recently created offers' khi store có 6 offer trở lên: số mục hiển thị

applicability.state: dashboard_view, >=6 offers

checks.precondition: Store has at least 6 offers of any status/type.
steps: Create 6 offers in sequence, noting creation order.
Navigate to Home, dashboard view.
Count and identify the items listed in 'Recently created offers'; note layout and any pagination.
checks.observation_point: 'Recently created offers' section item count, identity, layout
checks.open_question_draft: Conflict CONF-onboarding-dashboard-R1018-02 — Tài liệu (KB-007): 'Recently created offers' là list đúng 5 offer mới nhất (offer cũ thứ 6 bị loại), không phải bảng QVD-27. Staging 2026-10-18 (KB-030): section là bảng cột Internal name/Extension type/Status/Trigger/Combination/Actions, dữ liệu từ GET /api/offers?page=1&limit=5 (chưa quan sát với ≥6 offer). Expected hiện hành là gì (vẫn giới hạn 5 mục?)

checks.title: Onboarding->Dashboard switch triggers exactly at the 0->1 offer-count boundary, counting every status (no 'draft' status exists)

applicability.state: store offer count transition: 0 -> 1, any status

checks.precondition: Store currently has 0 offers (onboarding showing).
steps: Confirm onboarding is showing with 0 offers.
Create exactly 1 offer and immediately set/leave it in a non-active status (e.g. paused or expired), NOT active.
Navigate back to Home and observe which view renders.
checks.observation_point: Home view after the 0->1 offer-count transition, with the 1 offer in a non-active status
checks.expected_result: Dashboard view renders (not onboarding), because the threshold counts the offer regardless of status -- there being exactly 1 offer, in any status (no 'draft' status exists in this app), is sufficient to cross the boundary.

checks.title: Onboarding header rendering for unusually long/special-character/emoji store names

applicability.state: onboarding_empty_state (0 offers), store name is an edge-case value

checks.precondition: Store has 0 offers (onboarding showing) and the store's name is unusually long, contains special characters, or contains emoji.
steps: Set the store name to a long string (e.g. >60 characters), then separately to a string with special characters emoji.
Load the onboarding view for each case.
Record actual header rendering (truncation point, wrapping, overflow, emoji rendering).
checks.observation_point: Onboarding header 'Hello {{Store name}}!'
checks.expected_result: No confirmed expected truncation/overflow/emoji-handling behavior exists for this case. Record actual rendering as a baseline observation and route it to PO/Dev for confirmation before asserting pass/fail on any specific truncation rule.
checks.open_question_draft: What is the exact truncation/overflow behavior for the onboarding header 'Hello {{Store name}}!' when the store name is unusually long, contains special characters, or contains emoji? Source doc flags this explicitly as an untested edge case with no resolved expected behavior.

checks.title: Staff permission level required to view Home or perform onboarding/dashboard actions

applicability.state: any (onboarding or dashboard)

checks.precondition: A staff account with a restricted/non-owner permission level exists on the store.
steps: Log in as a staff account with a restricted permission level (e.g. no 'manage apps' or app-specific scope).
Attempt to view the app Home screen.
Attempt to click 'Create offer' and 'Enable theme app extension' 'Enable theme app'.
Record whether access is granted, denied, or partially restricted for each action.
checks.observation_point: Home screen access and CTA/button availability for a restricted staff account
checks.expected_result: No confirmed expected permission model exists for this feature. Record actual access behavior per permission level as a baseline observation and route to PO/Dev -- do not assert a specific pass/fail permission rule without confirmation.
checks.open_question_draft: What staff permission level, if any, is required to view Home (onboarding/dashboard), click 'Create offer', or click 'Enable theme app extension' 'Enable theme app'? No permission/role model is documented anywhere in the source doc for this feature.

checks.title: Deleting the only/all offers does not revert dashboard back to onboarding

applicability.state: store after deleting its only/all offers (offer count back to 0)

checks.precondition: Store has previously had >=1 offer (dashboard is showing) and currently has >=1 offer to delete.
steps: Confirm dashboard view is showing (store has had >=1 offer).
Delete the only/all remaining offer(s), bringing the current offer count to 0.
Navigate to Home and observe which view renders.
checks.observation_point: Home view after offer count returns to 0 via deletion
checks.expected_result: Dashboard view persists; onboarding does NOT reappear, because the store has historically had >=1 offer.

checks.title: Reinstall behavior depends on the store's historical offer-creation, not current offer count

applicability.state: app reinstall, prior offer-creation history varies

checks.precondition: Two store instances: (a) one that has never created an offer, (b) one that created >=1 offer and later deleted it/them.
steps: Uninstall and reinstall the app on store (a), which has never created an offer. Observe Home view.
Uninstall and reinstall the app on store (b), which previously created an offer (now deleted). Observe Home view.
checks.observation_point: Home view immediately after reinstall, for each store history
checks.expected_result: Store (a): onboarding reappears after reinstall. Store (b): onboarding stays hidden; dashboard shows, because the store previously created an offer even though it was later deleted.

checks.title: Multi-staff simultaneous Home sessions are store-wide state but not live-pushed

applicability.state: ≥2 staff sessions with Home open simultaneously, one creates an offer

checks.precondition: Two staff sessions (staff A, staff B) both have Home open; store currently has 0 offers.
steps: Open Home in two separate sessions (staff A, staff B), both showing onboarding (0 offers).
In staff A's session, create an offer (do not reload staff B's session).
Without reloading, observe staff B's already-open Home tab.
Reload staff B's tab and observe again.
checks.observation_point: Staff B's Home tab, before and after manual reload, following staff A's offer creation
checks.expected_result: Before reload: staff B's tab still shows Onboarding (no automatic real-time switch). After reload: staff B's tab shows Dashboard, since the state is store-wide.

checks.title: Externally toggling the theme app extension (outside the app) is reflected in the Theme Extension Status block with no in-app action

applicability.state: theme app extension toggled externally via Shopify theme editor

checks.precondition: Theme Extension Status is currently Inactive (or Active) in-app.
steps: Note the current Theme Extension Status shown in-app.
Go directly to the Shopify theme editor (not via the app's deep-link) and toggle the app embed/extension on or off.
Return to the app dashboard WITHOUT performing any in-app action, and observe the Theme Extension Status block.
checks.observation_point: Theme Extension Status block, dashboard, after an external-only toggle
checks.expected_result: The status block reflects the new state (Active/Inactive) that was set externally, without requiring any action inside the app.

checks.title: 'Enable theme app' deep-link opens the Theme Editor, auto-selects the published theme, and auto-inserts the app block

applicability.state: dashboard, Theme Extension Status block Inactive state, 'Enable theme app' button click

checks.precondition: Theme Extension Status is Inactive; store has a published/active theme and at least one other unpublished theme (to distinguish 'correct' theme selection).
steps: From Theme Extension Status = Inactive, click 'Enable theme app'.
Observe which tab/window opens and which theme is pre-selected in the Theme Editor.
Observe the relevant section (e.g. product page) for the auto-inserted app block.
Click Save as instructed.
checks.observation_point: Theme Editor tab opened by the deep-link: selected theme, inserted block, Save prompt
checks.expected_result: A new tab opens to the Shopify Theme Editor, with the currently active/published theme auto-selected (not any unpublished theme), the "Qikify: Volume Discount" app block auto-inserted into the relevant section (typically product page), and an instruction to click Save to apply.

checks.title: Setup Guide Step 2's 'Enable theme app extension' button reuses the identical deep-link mechanism as the Theme Extension Status block's button

applicability.state: setup guide, step 2 button behavior

checks.precondition: Theme Extension Status is Inactive; Setup Guide Step 2 is not yet completed.
steps: From the Theme Extension Status block, note the exact destination/behavior of 'Enable theme app' (theme selected, block inserted).
Reset state if needed, then trigger Setup Guide Step 2's 'Enable theme app extension' button instead.
Compare the resulting destination/behavior between the two entry points.
checks.observation_point: Destination and auto-selection/insertion behavior triggered by each of the two buttons
checks.expected_result: Both buttons produce the same outcome (same theme auto-selected, same app block auto-inserted, same Save prompt) -- Setup Guide Step 2 does not implement a separate/divergent deep-link path.

checks.title: Onboarding<->Dashboard switch is driven by the discount-offers object's offer count, evaluated lazily only on Home navigation

applicability.state: cross-feature dependency: offer existence owned by discount-offers object

checks.precondition: Store currently on onboarding (0 offers).
steps: With Home open showing onboarding, create an offer via a path that does not itself navigate to Home (e.g. from a different admin route, if available) or via another already-open tab.
Without reloading the Home tab, confirm it still shows onboarding.
Navigate to Home fresh (new navigation) and confirm it now shows dashboard.
checks.observation_point: Home view across the already-open tab vs. a fresh navigation, after offer creation
checks.expected_result: The already-open Home tab does not switch views on its own (no live push); only a fresh navigation to Home re-evaluates the offer count and switches to dashboard. This mirrors the cross-feature dependency: the switch is driven by the discount-offers object's data, not by this feature's own state.

checks.title: Dashboard ATC click stat identity vs. the standalone Analytics feature's metric

applicability.state: dashboard, ATC click stat widget, cross-feature with Analytics ("Analytics", out of this shard's scope)

checks.precondition: Store has ATC click activity visible in both the Dashboard ATC widget and the standalone Analytics feature.
steps: Generate a known number of add-to-cart click events attributable to an offer.
Record the Dashboard ATC click stat value.
Record the corresponding metric in the standalone Analytics feature for the same period/offer.
Compare the two values.
checks.observation_point: Dashboard ATC click stat widget value vs. Analytics feature's equivalent metric, same time window
checks.expected_result: No confirmed expected relationship exists between the two metrics. Record whether the values match (same counter) or diverge (independent counters) as a baseline observation and route to PO/Dev for confirmation before treating test coverage of one as coverage of the other.
checks.open_question_draft: Is the Dashboard ATC (add-to-cart) click stat (KB-018, QVD-115) the same underlying counter/metric as the standalone Analytics feature's ("Analytics") metric, or an independent counter?

checks.title: Backend persistence (or absence thereof) behind the onboarding<->dashboard switch and Setup Guide progress

applicability.state: any -- concerns implementation layer, not a specific UI state

checks.precondition: None specific -- this check targets whatever backend mechanism (if any) computes the switch/progress.
steps: With access to network/API tooling, trigger an offer-count change and Setup Guide step completion.
Inspect network calls made by Home on load, looking for any dedicated endpoint returning switch-state or setup-guide-progress (as opposed to a generic offer list used to derive it client-side).
If found, verify behavior under a simulated stale/failed response (e.g. endpoint timeout) for a regression oracle to attach to later; if not found (purely client-derived), record that.
checks.observation_point: Network calls made by the Home screen on load/navigation
checks.expected_result: No confirmed expected implementation exists (client-derived vs. dedicated backend endpoint/cache). Record actual implementation as a baseline observation and route to PO/Dev -- a dedicated backend path, if it exists, is currently untested and has zero oracle coverage for its own failure modes.
checks.open_question_draft: Is the onboarding<->dashboard view switch and Setup Guide step-completion progress computed purely client-side from the offer list at render time, or is there a dedicated backend endpoint/table/cache behind it that could itself go stale, fail, or regress independently of the offer list?

checks.title: The retired QVD-31 warning banner must not reappear alongside the Theme Extension Status block

applicability.state: dashboard view, current (post-QVD-66) state: banner absent, status block present

checks.precondition: Dashboard view is showing (store has >=1 offer), Theme Extension Status block is present.
steps: Navigate to Home, dashboard view.
Trigger the scenario that historically showed the QVD-31 banner: create an offer while the theme app extension is not yet enabled.
Observe the full dashboard for any transient warning banner in addition to the permanent Theme Extension Status block.
checks.observation_point: Dashboard, immediately after creating an offer with the extension still inactive
checks.expected_result: No separate transient warning banner appears. Only the permanent Theme Extension Status block (Inactive state) is shown. If a warning banner is observed in addition to the status block, this is a regression to retired QVD-31 behavior and must be flagged as a defect, not treated as an intentional new feature.

steps: Create >=6 offers of mixed status.

checks.observation_point: 'Recently created offers' section structure (list vs. table, presence of pagination)
checks.open_question_draft: Conflict CONF-onboarding-dashboard-R1018-02 — Tài liệu (KB-007): section là list đơn giản 5 offer mới nhất + nút 'Manage offers'/'Create offer'; bảng phân trang cột Name/Status/Trigger/Combination/Actions của QVD-27 xuất hiện lại là regression. checks.title: Card 'Add to cart click' chỉ hiện khi store có offer; window 30 ngày kết thúc hôm qua theo giờ trình duyệt

coverage_by_feature_and_risk.risk: Onboarding empty-state is a direct fix for a Shopify App Store review flag (B4S); regression in post-install render carries App Store compliance risk, not just a UX bug.

The retired QVD-31 warning banner reappearing alongside the Theme Extension Status block is a regression to pre-QVD-66 behavior and must be flagged as a defect, not assumed to be an intentional new feature.
Multi-staff/simultaneous-session Home view is not live-updated; a QA tester running 2 sessions could misread the stale onboarding/dashboard state as a bug when it is documented, expected behavior.

Core onboarding<->dashboard switch logic (offer-count threshold across all statuses, stickiness, reinstall, delete-all) is the feature's central business rule -- a regression here mis-routes every merchant on Home.
Theme extension enablement path blocks offer visibility on the storefront if broken -- a revenue-impacting cross-surface (portal -> Shopify Theme Editor) deep-link.
No documented staff permission model for Home or its primary actions -- access-control regressions currently have no oracle to test against.
CONF-onboarding-dashboard-R1018-01/02 — thành phần Dashboard và layout 'Recently created offers' giữa tài liệu và staging; test case không có oracle.
Mục mới: Theme extension 'Inactive' tạm thời lúc tải; Setup guide quay về 1/2 sau khi xoá hết offer; window ATC theo giờ trình duyệt.
